description:
Deploy web-c3d4 to production at app.example.com, once.

## What happens

```bash
pnpm run deploy
```

## Impact

- No downtime; deploying the previous release undoes it.

## How we'll check

- `GET /healthz` answers `200`.

If you say no, web-c3d4 stays unreleased.
